Prime Video / Hold My Popcorn

One dialogue. One bucket. One mind reader.

Suhani Shah takes film knowledge and a little mind-reading to the street.

Client / PlatformPrime Video
The workConcept · Visual identity · Production

The idea in practice.

We conceptualised a gamified vox-pop series in which a participant thinks of a famous dialogue from a film or show while trying to finish a bucket of popcorn.

Before the popcorn runs out, Suhani reads their cues and tries to guess the dialogue. A simple rule gives the street interaction a clock, a challenge, and a reveal.

A clear game makes room for spontaneous entertainment.
